facts.scope: Name and source-system classification only; project meter/damage/choreography remain adaptations.
The guide romanization Hyojin corresponds to the project label Touga Hyoujin; no new freeze rule.

indexedIdentityReferences.quote: a blue beret with a metal plate
indexedIdentityReferences.application: Use old NOL blue beret and sleeveless tunic rather than the local cape/bareheaded costume.

indexedIdentityReferences.quote: Usually appearing as a stubby red bat
indexedIdentityReferences.application: Gii is red, while Nago is the separate black cat umbrella.

indexedIdentityReferences.quote: a long black coat with two large golden buckles on it, and a matching black fedora
indexedIdentityReferences.application: The local long coat is broadly consistent; do not claim that its length itself was an error.

indexedIdentityReferences.quote: his left eye being green and his right being red
indexedIdentityReferences.application: Anatomical side intent: right eye red and Azure Grimoire right arm; left/two-handed sword poses are an authored grip choice, not a claim of exclusively left-handed source animation.

localReferenceReview.ragna: Red/black costume and white hair broadly coherent; old base omits Blood-Scythe during its punching attack row.
localReferenceReview.jin: Old base is visibly another Ragna with white hair and red coat. New art corrects entire identity to blond Jin/blue-white NOL/Yukianesa.
localReferenceReview.noel: Old base is bareheaded, has cape/white blouse and no visible Bolverk; new art uses CSE beret/sleeveless old NOL outfit and twin pistols.
localReferenceReview.rachel_bb: Old parasol/black-white-red costume broadly recognizable, but Gii is black and an attack row is a pink laser ring. New art corrects red Gii and appropriate Nago/rod/lightning action.
localReferenceReview.hazama_bb: Old fedora, green hair and long coat are broadly recognizable; new art replaces generic green duplicate/laser shapes with visible linked Ouroboros and snake hook.

limits: Every native source, exact prompt and input image used by successful calls is archived with actual SHA256 in the two PartA provenance ledgers.
Sharp only segments/extracts/scales uniformly/packs real native frames; renderScale metadata changes canvas size, not PNG anatomy.
All poses and timings are authored adaptations; no source-game screenshot, frame-perfect behavior, 1:1 appearance or visual network verification is certified.
P2 mirrors the entire sprite as a gameplay convention, including anatomical left/right asymmetries.
